items.context:
Day 27 - Favorite final level theme: Super Mario 64 - Bowser's Road Gonna be honest, I drew a blank on final levels/dungeons because I'm trying my hardest to not do duplicates from games 😂 but then I remembered the first game I ever finished! Bowser was always my favorite and this music is bomb ❤️
link card: Super Mario 64 Soundtrack - Bowser's Road; quotes @local-enigma.bsky.social: yippee!!
items.text: Bowser's Road is such a good pick. That organ-heavy final theme sets the mood perfectly for a first finished game.
